RunningResume: Running · go back to it whenever you like
BackToDesktopBody: Hides the home: c0n50le stays in the notification area.
EmptyBody: Add a game, or pick the folder to import from in System → Library. Steam and Epic are read on their own.
AddGameBody: Pick an executable: a game, an emulator or an app.
RemoveGameBody: Remove "{0}" from the library? The executable stays where it is.
CloseFailed: The game didn't accept closing: quit it from its own menu.
GameHidden: "{0}" is hidden. Find it in System → Library → Hidden games.
CloseOtherFirst: Close {0} first: one game at a time.
WindowNotReady: The game's window isn't ready yet.
WindowNotFound: The game's window wasn't found. If it starts through a launcher, set the process to follow in Edit.
PreferencesUnreadable: The settings can't be read and won't be overwritten: {0}
FoundGameNote: Comes from {0}: name and path can't be changed here.
PickResult: Pick a result to see its cover and background.
NoResults: No title found. Try another name.
GamesFolderBody: Each subfolder becomes a game: c0n50le picks the executable with the same name.
ScanSteamBody: Shows the games installed with Steam.
ScanEpicBody: Shows the games installed with the Epic Games Launcher.
RescanBody: Reads the folder, Steam and Epic again and looks up missing covers.
HiddenGamesBody: Games taken off the home. Pick one to show it again.
ShowAgain: Pick the game to show again.
HomeScreenBody: Where c0n50le opens full screen, the TV for example.
InterfaceScaleBody: Makes everything bigger or smaller, to read well from where you play.
ControllerShortcutBody: Press these buttons together while playing to come back to the home.
ShortcutInUse: Another app already uses that key: pick another.
ShowSystemCardBody: A card at the end of the row opens System. The icon at the top right always stays.
InterfaceSoundsBody: Short sounds as you move and pick.
HomeMusicBody: Light music while you're on the home. It stops when you play.
IntroSettingBody: The name of c0n50le with a sound, while the library loads.
TourAgainBody: The guided tour of the first start.
StartWithWindowsBody: Opens c0n50le when you sign in.
OpenFullscreenBody: When off, c0n50le starts in the notification area at sign-in.
CloseToTray: Stay in the notification area when closed
CloseToTrayBody: Closing the window doesn't quit the app.
ExitAppBody: Removes the icon from the notification area too.
ExitWhileRunning: A game is running: it will stay open. Quit anyway?
CheckUpdatesBody: From GitHub, checked with SHA-256 before installing.
CheckNowBody: Looks for a newer version right away.
UpdateAvailable: Update available: {0}. Install it from System → Updates.
CopyDiagnosticsBody: Version, settings and log, without the names of your games or your folders.
TourWelcomeBody: The home of your games, made for the sofa with a controller or with mouse and keyboard: the interface adapts by itself to what you use.
TourLibraryBody: One card per game: your Steam and Epic games, the games folder and the executables you add. The last played come first.
TourCardOptionsBody: With {2} or ⋯ you edit the game, search for another cover or hide it from the home.
TourReturnHomeBody: While playing, press {0} or {1} on the controller to come back here. The game stays open and you resume it from its card.
TourSystemBody: Theme, screen, controls, start with Windows and updates.
TourDoneBody: You can take this tour again in System → Look and sound.
